review:
The game is very short and simple. All you have to do is survive for 90 seconds. But the real question is: can you survive those 90 seconds?

0–10s: You don't need anything to survive. Too easy.
10–20s: You need to start understanding the game.
20–30s: You'll need a little skills , earned from dying again and again.
30–40s: Now you need a real skills .
40–50s: You need the developers' help.
60s+: Not gonna lie... only God can help you here.

shorts but gold 10/10 game .

Amazing arcade game, impressive original soundtrack and cyberpunk atmosphere. It doesn't have a story or anything like that, it's just a pure arcade and frenetic game. There's four different game modes and they're all nice and challenging. Just play and enjoy :b (and it's made by a brazillian developer, so this is awesome too). 
Oh, if you enjoyed the songs, they're all available in Walter Machado's Youtube channel. 

Curiosity about the change of weapons (I marked this as a spoiler 'cause it might be fun to discover it for yourself):
[spoiler]When you step on a weapon, you automatically switch to it, even if you don't want to. However, if you get the best weapon (the one that shoots red lasers in multiple directions), stepping on any other weapon won't switch it, so you can move freely and calmly around the map after picking it up, without fear of switching to an inferior weapon.[/spoiler]

Ubermosh - это аркадный динамичный и сложный шутер. Мне он понравился графикой, рисовка очень приятная. Музыка тоже. Геймплей  понятный и можно быстро разобраться что да как. Но в тоже время здесь довольно сложно играть: враги окружают тебя и пули летят со всех сторон.
 Игру рекомендую! Можно поиграть часик, испытать свою скорость и внимательность, тем более за такую небольшую цену :)
Прикольная  игрулька!. Есть пару персов за каждого интересно играть. Из плюсов: Сложность, визуал и музон. Из минусов? Да нету их. Игра так на 8 из 10.
